name: KiTS19 Challenge
description: An evaluation of state-of-the-art kidney and kidney tumor segmentation methods using the KiTS19 dataset and challenge framework on contrast-enhanced CT scans.
reputation: Widely used and respected in the medical image segmentation community as a standard benchmark for kidney and tumor segmentation.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; relatively small dataset (challenge-scale), label variability across annotators, evaluation primarily via Dice and surface metrics; potential for overfitting to challenge-specific priors.
